lha.guidance: These names are the reference shortlist already used on this site. They are not an address match. Bristol and Gloucestershire each span more than one BRMA. Manchester is not a single rate. Use the VOA full-postcode lookup, then pick the BRMA by its official name. Edinburgh is a Monday placeholder only. No Edinburgh rate is shown, because this site does not map a city to a BRMA.
